baseline.overlay: Identical benchmark source and Cargo registration only; no runtime edits.

candidate.overlay: None; committed candidate runtime and benchmark source.

host.profile: bench: opt-level=3, thin LTO, one codegen unit

preregistration.baseline_kind: PR fork point, not latest main

protocol:
Fixed-work 1/4/8-writer comparison of runtime 0198bb3d against PR fork point a703cc0f.
Reuse the exact independently built and checksum-verified binaries from the completed single-stream qualification.
Current HEAD dfe0492c changes only tests, evidence scripts, formal models and documentation relative to that runtime.
One warm-up pair (--round 0) is retained separately, then five measured pairs with rounds 0..4.
Revision order: baseline first for warm-up/even rounds, candidate first for odd rounds.
Each process runs every one of the 18 cases (three storage modes, 1/4/8 writers, with/without serialized host control), 256 commits each.
No adaptive stopping, no sample removal, and no build or test overlaps timing.
Validate exact data/epoch/reopen/worker totals, all sample counts/percentiles and group counters before accepting each execution.
Primary scaling evidence: all five paired throughput ratios for grouped concurrent API at 4 and 8 writers; report medians against both fork-point and same-binary host-serialized controls, plus candidate 1-writer scaling and exact shared-sync counts.
Report all other storage/writer/control cases and their latency summaries as well, without selecting only favorable results.
These five-round descriptive results do not replace the predeclared 40-pair zero-increase single-stream latency gate and do not prove general workload scaling or fairness.
Host/cache/affinity and temporal drift limitations are unchanged; process resource logs include fixture and verification work.
